title: Cratelock
tagline: A password manager on web3 built with extra security and default two factor verification.
description: Cratelock allows us to store usernames and passwords and access them anytime with the help of the Cratelock Password! I've made this so that two factors are needed to access the passwords store with the help of your wallet address and a designated password. I've used solidity as much as possible and I managed to do accomplish as much as possible considering I'm new to web3 and blockchain.
how_its_made: I've used solidity to create both the authentication program to login and logout of an account and the storage for the usernames and password. I used remix to trial and run my code and ended up in a huge mess over syntax errors and not getting the result i intend to get. I'm new to web3 and I learnt as much as I could to come up with this project and help me grow.
